# NEW S68a pedestal-restoration timing-shape benchmark with pile-up onset nuisance

Academic-grade study: compare a traditional spline baseline-restored constant-fraction plus matched-template time estimator against ridge, gradient-boosted trees, MLP, 1D-CNN, and a compact waveform transformer.

Require run-held-out and stave-held-out splits, bootstrap 95% CIs for timing bias, sigma68, tail rate, and calibration slope, plus ablations for pedestal window length, pulse shape residuals, pile-up onset, and saturation flags.

Deliverables: concise REPORT.md, method_metrics.csv, strata_metrics.csv, event_predictions.csv.gz, leakage_checks.csv, and reproduction_match_table.csv. Interpret which pulse-shape features carry timing information after pedestal drift and early pile-up are controlled.
